# UC-0C Testing Files

## Input Files (from data/budget/)
- `ward_budget.csv` — 300 rows, 5 wards × 5 categories × 12 months, 5 deliberate null actual_spend values

## Output Files (generated by app.py)
- `growth_output.csv` — Per-ward per-category MoM growth table for Ward 1 – Kasba, Roads & Pothole Repair

## Run Command
```bash
python app.py --input ../data/budget/ward_budget.csv --ward "Ward 1 – Kasba" --category "Roads & Pothole Repair" --growth-type MoM --output growth_output.csv
```

## Verification
- Reference values: 2024-07: 19.7 actual, +33.1% growth; 2024-10: 13.1 actual, -34.8% growth
- Null rows flagged: Ward 2 – Shivajinagar Drainage 2024-03, Ward 4 – Warje Roads 2024-07
- Formula shown in every output row (e.g., "MoM: (19.7 - 14.8) / |14.8| * 100")
- Cross-ward/category aggregation refused
- --growth-type required (MoM or YoY), never guessed
